data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (convert two quotes to USD on xe, look up the supplier city's time on timeanddate, fill the To/Subject/Body of the procurement email) with the right order and parameters, but it ends with "Send" where the true workflow says to click Discard and never send. It also adds a currency parameter split and a recipient parameter that is actually fixed, and it is vague on the Mail tab and body details like <which>.
